notes:
**Residents:** INS 2021 Population and Housing Census, total population per UAT (6 Bucharest sectors + 40 Ilfov towns/communes; totals 1,716,961 and 542,704, checked against the county totals). Spread over Overture building footprints (OSM-tagged where available) by residential floor area = footprint × floors (OSM building:levels/height, Overture height, otherwise generic defaults by building type: large blocs 8 floors, apartments 5, houses 1.5).

**Jobs:** no per-area workplace data used. Trip destinations = 62% of residents (workers + commuting students), split 83% Bucharest / 17% Ilfov from INS county employee counts (2025-26). Within each county, placed by building-type floor area with generic job densities (office, retail, mall, industrial, warehouse, education, health, public, hotel) plus OSM shop/office/amenity POIs, then adjusted by hand-tuned zone multipliers for known business districts (Pipera, Floreasca, Băneasa, A1/DN2 logistics, Titan/Republica) and residential estates.

**Flows:** no measured O/D. Doubly-constrained gravity model (exponential decay, Furness balancing, calibrated to a 9.5 km mean trip) against the resident and destination totals above, sampled into pops ≤200. Driving times from OSRM on OSM.

**Special demand (unscored):** airport, universities, malls, stadium, convention centre, parks, hospitals added with depot add_points; visitor/student figures are author estimates.

Vintages: census 2021, employee totals 2025-26, OSM/Overture 2026. Pipeline: https://github.com/naealexandru95-del/sb-bucharest-ilfov — Reviewer refinements (2026-11-06): workplace_intensity re-ruled coarse_sector, not fine_types_generic — 85% of the OSM buildings in the frame are untyped building=yes, which the pipeline classes from the enclosing land-use polygon and footprint size (office / retail / industrial / warehouse / education / health / mixed), a handful of broad types spread by floor area; explicitly typed non-residential buildings are 1.8% of the stock. The floor term compounds the tagging bias: floors come from OSM building:levels / height or Overture height where present and from a per-type default elsewhere (office 6, retail 1.5, industrial 1, clipped to 45), but only 2.2% of the rendered buildings (6.8% of footprint) carry a real height, concentrated on the typed non-residential stock (60% of it height-tagged vs 13% of all OSM buildings). Outside the hand-painted zones, cells where at least 25% of the footprint has a real height receive ~29 jobs per 1,000 m² of footprint vs 6.4 where heights are absent (matched cells over 2 ha: 12.4 vs 2.7), so job placement tracks OSM mapping detail as much as building use. The hand-tuned zone multipliers (Pipera ×3 overlapping Floreasca ×2.5, Băneasa ×2.5 and others) dominate the top of the distribution: 18 of the 20 largest job cells sit in zones, 8 of them with no height data, and the top 1% of cells hold 32% of grid jobs on 2% of the footprint. Remaining answers CONFIRMED as filed. workplace_count estimated_proxy — trip destinations are 62% of residents, split 83/17 between Bucharest and Ilfov by INS county employee counts; no per-area workplace count. workplace_granularity adm2 — the measured content is that two-county split, and Bucharest (~1.16M of ~1.40M modelled jobs) is a single municipality that is also a county-level ADM1 unit, the vienna shape (middle of ADM3 municipal / ADM1 county). resident_granularity adm3 — INS 2021 census population per UAT: Ilfov's 40 towns and communes (~14k people each) are municipal units (the rubric's CZ obec / PL gmina) and Bucharest's 6 sectors (~286k each) are ward-scale (tehran precedent). Overture footprints with OSM tags score ml_hybrid_footprints; residents by residential floor area with type-based floor defaults stay fine_types_generic (calibrated per UAT). od_metric none — the gravity model is doubly constrained (Furness), but the destination totals are residents × 62% rather than measured per area and the 9.5 km mean-trip target has no stated source. Alternatives on record: fine_types_generic as filed 0.19; binary_split 0.17; prior_informed_synthetic O/D (if the 9.5 km target comes from a domestic travel survey) +0.015 — very-low throughout. First scored RO map (bucharest-medium is deprecated and unscored); sets the RO floor. Revised very-low 0.19 -> very-low 0.18.
